name: Diamond OA funding strategies in Europe
organization: ALMASI project and contributing institutions (Slovenia, ANR, TU Delft, Université de Lorraine, TIB, SCOSS)
description: How European funders, universities and libraries can finance Diamond OA publishing: national policies, library portfolio funding, consortial models such as TIB's KOALA, and internationally coordinated support through SCOSS.
